arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Shaffer argued Congress can make states pay for infringing federal rights. He stated this follows from the Constitution's text.
Mr. Park argued state sovereign immunity is a fundamental constitutional feature. He stated immunity from private money damages remains inherent in sovereignty.
Justice Ginsburg questioned the applicability of the patent decision to this case. She noted the same secure and exclusivity language appears in both.
Justice Kagan asked if the Court must revisit the Florida Prepaid rule. She questioned if the sides that brought the case' view requires overturning that precedent.
